description_en: Updates the basic information and specification configurations of an ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance
description_zh: 更新云消息队列 RocketMQ 版实例的基本信息和规格配置
name: UpdateInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to be updated
parameters.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The authentication type of the instance
fields.name: acl_types

fields.help_en: Indicates whether authentication-free access is enabled for VPC connections under the intelligent identity recognition type
fields.help_zh: 是否智能身份识别类型下，VPC接入免密访问
fields.name: default_vpc_auth_free

fields.help_en:
The public network access IP whitelist.

If the IP whitelist is not configured, all IP address ranges are allowed to access the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ server over the public network by default.
If the IP whitelist is configured, only IP addresses in the whitelist are allowed to access the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ server over the public network
fields.help_zh:
公网访问IP白名单列表。

若不配置IP白名单，则默认放通所有IP地址段通过公网访问云消息队列 RocketMQ 版服务端。
若配置IP白名单，则仅允许白名单内的IP地址通过公网访问云消息队列 RocketMQ 版服务端
fields.name: ip_whitelist

fields.help_en: The public network information. This parameter is valid only when the public network access feature is enabled for the instance
fields.help_zh: 公网信息，仅当实例开通公网访问功能时，该参数有效
fields.name: internet_info

parameters.help_en: The updated network information of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 更新后的实例网络信息
parameters.name: network_info

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable burstable elastic capacity beyond the specification.

After burstable elastic capacity is enabled, ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ allows the instance to exceed the TPS limit of the base specification within a certain range. The portion that exceeds the base specification incurs additional elastic specification fees. For more information about billing, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/427237.html.


Only instances of specific specifications support burstable elastic capacity. For more information about supported instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/444715.html
fields.help_zh:
是否开启规格外突发弹性能力。

开启弹性突发能力后，云消息队列 RocketMQ 版允许该实例在一定范围内超过基础规格限制的TPS，且超过基础规格外的部分，需要收取额外的弹性规格费用。具体计费信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/427237.html。


仅部分规格的实例支持开启弹性突发规格能力，具体支持的实例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/444715.html
fields.name: auto_scaling

fields.help_en:
The message retention period. Unit: hours.

For the valid value range, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440347.html > Resource Quotas > Message Retention Period.

The log broker in ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ is fully serverless and elastic, and fees are charged based on actual storage space. You can control the storage capacity of messages by adjusting the message retention period. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/427238.html
fields.help_zh:
消息保存时长。单位：小时。

取值范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440347.html>资源配额>消息保存时长的限制值。

云消息队列 RocketMQ 版的消息存储完全实现Serverless弹性，按照实际存储空间收取费用，您可以通过调整消息保存时长来控制消息的存储容量。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/427238.html
fields.name: message_retention_time

fields.help_en:
The ratio of message sending to accepting.

Valid values: [0.25, 1]
fields.help_zh:
消息发送和接收的比例。

取值范围：[0.25，1]
fields.name: send_receive_ratio

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the message trace feature.

<props="intl">This parameter does not take effect. Regardless of whether this parameter is enabled, the instance supports the trace feature by default.</props>
<props="china">This parameter takes effect only for Serverless instances. If the message trace feature is enabled, message trace fees are incurred. For more information about billing, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2586280.html.</props>
<props="china">For pay-as-you-go and subscription instances, this parameter does not take effect. Regardless of whether this parameter is enabled, the message trace feature is supported by default.</props>
fields.help_zh:
是否开启消息轨迹功能。

<props="intl">该参数暂不生效，不管参数是否开启，实例都默认支持轨迹功能。</props>
<props="china">该参数仅对Serverless类型的实例生效，若开启消息轨迹功能，会产生相关的消息轨迹费用，具体计费信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2586280.html。</props>
<props="china">对于按量付费和包年包月实例，该参数不生效，即不管参数是否开启，都默认支持消息轨迹功能。</props>
fields.name: trace_on
